senses.gloss: m.(b. h. spreading, grapes spread on the ground; spreading place.
units: Toh. X, 4 הנותן … ומן המ׳ של אדמה he who puts in the press grapes collected in baskets or such as were spread on the (naked) ground; ib. מן המ׳ של עלים grapes spread on leaves. Tosef. ib. XI, 8. Y’lamd. to Num. VII, 1 ממלא מִשְׁטֵחוֹ he fills his spreading place.—Pl. מִשְׁטֵחִים, מִשְׁטֵחִין, מִשְׁטֵי׳ layers.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 98:1">Sifré Num. 98</cite> <he>שהיתה עשויה מ׳ מ׳</he> the quails formed layers; <cite ref="Yoma 75b:4">Yoma 75ᵇ</cite>
